text:
Marta: Quick idea — rather than immediately autopause a canary when cost/latency spikes, what about a 'soft slowdown' guard that temporarily reduces canary weight and watches telemetry? Could avoid unnecessary rollbacks.
Kevin: That sounds promising. UX-wise, console should show the active slowdown % + remaining duration. maybe a slider and a quick reason note. :thinking: 
Jia: Need to clarify billing semantics — if we slow traffic vs route to a cheaper model it's different. We also need to record token accounting for the reduced window so cost alerts don't double-count.
Sam: Implementation note: we already have holdback and pause actions. Soft slowdown should be an action that adjusts traffic weights (not replace the model). Keep semantics simple: reduce canary weight by X% over Y seconds.
Marta: PoC policy DSL (sketch):
```
guard "soft_slowdown" {
  when p95_latency > 600ms or token_cost > baseline * 1.5
  action reduce_traffic_by = 30% over = "90s"
  cooldown = "3m"
  notify = ["#oncall", "owner"]
  rollback_when p95_latency <= baseline * 1.1
}
```
ops-bot: alert: canary/ret-model-3 breached p95=710ms at 17:28 UTC (rule=latency-p95, env=staging) :eyes: 
Kevin: Two operational concerns: (1) oscillation with autoscaler/throughput controller — need cooldown and idempotent weight reconciliation, (2) composability with other guards (e.g., cost autopause). We should define precedence.
Jia: Telemetry requirements: tag every decision with guard=soft_slowdown, reason, and before/after windows (p50/p95/err). Also emit a billing delta event for the period. Console should show a 2-panel diff: pre-window vs post-window.
Sam: API idea: PATCH /rollouts/:id/guards with body {"type":"soft_slowdown","reduce_by":0.2,"over":"90s","cooldown":"3m","conditions":[...]}. Response should return an action_id and explanation. Allow float percentages.
Marta: UX defaults: safe default reduce_by=20%, preview mode (simulate without changing traffic), and an explicit "escalate to pause" toggle if slowdown doesn't improve within window. Owners can opt-out per rollout.
Kevin: I'll put together a short design doc covering precedence rules and failure modes (e.g., if the slowdown network path causes artifacts). Not high priority for this sprint but want the spec soon.
Jia: I'll draft telemetry + billing spec and outline the event shapes. Will add expected dashboards/widgets for the Console team.
Sam: I'll sketch the API + wireframe for the Console preview panel and open a PR with examples.
Marta: Great — thanks. If anyone has quick objections about semantics (reduce weight vs redirect), speak now. Otherwise we'll follow up with PRs and a single design doc link. :thumbsup:
